V34__fixed_categories_platform_fee.sql locked the catalogue to five slugs with a per-category platform fee; Toys is the sixth permanent category (named alongside the others in V103__events_are_occasions.sql, themed in V88 and V105) and was created through the admin categories console, so its fee lives in that console rather than in a migration.
_note: Six: Grocery, Hardware, Furniture, Fashion, Toys, Others — the categories a vendor can register under and the six tabs of the customer app's category rail.

_toysFee: CHECK THIS ONE NUMBER: Toys' platform_fee_percent is set in the admin console (Categories → Toys → Platform fee) and is not in any repository. 3% is assumed, matching the other retail aisles. If the console says otherwise, change it here and in fees.json — every page, the estimator and the vendor planner follow.
